response.sql: WITH rep_counts AS (SELECT e.EmployeeId, e.City, COUNT(c.CustomerId) as customer_count FROM Employee e LEFT JOIN Customer c ON e.EmployeeId = c.SupportRepId WHERE c.CustomerId IS NOT NULL GROUP BY e.EmployeeId, e.City), city_avgs AS (SELECT rc.City, AVG(rc.customer_count) as city_avg FROM rep_counts rc GROUP BY rc.City), filtered_reps AS (SELECT rc.EmployeeId, rc.City, rc.customer_count, ca.city_avg FROM rep_counts rc JOIN city_avgs ca ON rc.City = ca.City WHERE rc.customer_count > ca.city_avg), overall_total AS (SELECT SUM(customer_count) as total FROM filtered_reps) SELECT fr.City, SUM(fr.customer_count) as total_customers, AVG(fr.customer_count - fr.city_avg) as avg_above_city_avg, AVG(fr.customer_count / ot.total) as avg_rep_share FROM filtered_reps fr CROSS JOIN overall_total ot GROUP BY fr.City
